title: FRP Deck Board - ICST - Thailand
description: Call for Volume Specials! More decking and grating available.

paragraphs: Non-skid FRP decking is designed to replace wood or other less versatile surfaces such as steel or aluminum. FRP decking is strong and non-corrosive surface providing a long-term solution for applications such as walkways, deck, systems, and roofing.

bullets.text: Does not rust, rot or bow
